note: Skills (job 87, approved protocol 37; Dave's design DESIGN_IDEAS 5.4). Two layers. ACTIONS (job 70 hooks): every action that a skill speeds up or improves asks skill_factor(peer, action); 'effect' says what the factor scales (yield, speed, toughness). SKILLS: each skill has an innate part (neutral_level plus attr_scale x the sum of weight x attribute, attributes run -10..10, so an average character sits at neutral_level and every factor is exactly 1.0), a trained part (books and teachers, none yet) and practice. Level = base + (100 - base) x (1 - exp(-k x practice)), smooth, so tuning is k per skill. Working level = own level + parent_weight x the group's level (groups are skills too: practice goes 80 percent to the skill and 20 percent to its parent). Factor = 1 + (max_factor - 1) x (working - neutral) / (100 - neutral), never below min_factor. Practice comes only from successes the server verified: gain = gain_per_success x difficulty x (1 - level/100), nothing for trivial work (difficulty under trivial_below), a cooldown per skill, and a soft cap per game day. An unused skill decays lazily (computed when next touched): after grace_days idle, practice halves every half_life_days, never below floor_share of the best it reached; practice regained below the peak counts regain_mult times. 'Rusty' shows when practice is under rusty_below of the peak. Gains involve no dice, so luck does not enter (luck still rolls the yields).
